section.heading: A unified vision for learning, care, and growth.
section.description: Our principal, manager, and coordinator share one mission: to shape confident, respectful students in a school environment rooted in values, excellence and community.

cards.name: Mrs. Ranju Singh
cards.message: Leadership at Noza Convent School means nurturing every student with clarity, care, and a purposeful direction. We focus on creating a culture of achievement, wellbeing, and strong values.
cards.quote: Our strength is in steady guidance and thoughtful support for every learner.

cards.name: Mritunjai kumar Mishra
cards.message: At Noza Convent School, strong academic performance grows from a caring school culture. We support students to discover their talents while holding fast to respect, resilience, and community values.
cards.quote: Academic excellence must be matched with compassion and character.

cards.name: Mrs. Priyanka Srivastava
cards.message: Our coordination team keeps teaching pathways aligned and learning experiences fresh. We ensure every student receives personalized support, creativity, and the structure they need to thrive.
cards.quote: Great learning happens when every classroom moves forward together.
